SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for JWT and security (generate: python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))')

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL database URL (set by Railway PostgreSQL plugin)

REDIS_URL.description: Redis URL (set by Railway Redis plugin)

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g., https://yourdomain.com)

S3_SECURE.description: Use HTTPS for S3 (true for AWS S3/B2, false for local MinIO)

PORT.description: Port for FastAPI (Railway will set this)
